subject: Kickoff: BrightLeaf renewal — timeline, staffing, QBR window
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Maria Perez <maria.perez@brightleaf.com>, BrightLeaf Procurement <procurement@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: BrightLeaf renewal — timeline, staffing, QBR window

Hi Maria / BrightLeaf team —

Thanks again for a great year. With BrightLeaf's renewal coming up in late July, I wanted to kick off a short renewal coordination thread to align timeline, owners, and an initial QBR window. Goal is to have a signed amendment by 2028-07-22 and a QBR in the first week of August to cover the new throughput commitments.

Suggested initial milestones:
- Week of 2028-05-15: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft (ownership: Redwood Sales + BrightLeaf PO)
- Week of 2028-05-22: Security & procurement checklist delivered (ownership: Redwood Security / BrightLeaf procurement)
- 2028-06-05: Internal exec alignment at BrightLeaf (prep window for QBR agenda)
- 2028-07-15: Legal & billing signoff complete
- Target: Amendment signed by 2028-07-22, QBR first week of August

For scheduling the QBR, can you confirm which of these windows work for you (we can host 1-hour remote):
- Tue 2028-08-01, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 2028-08-02, 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 2028-08-03, 09:00–10:00 PT

I've attached a one-page MAP template and a draft QBR agenda to this thread to speed collaboration. Monica will drive the operational runbook and Rishi will author the performance/ capacity proposal. Stephanie is looped for any contract/legal items.

Next steps (from our side):
1) We'll populate the MAP and send version 1 by 2028-05-15.
2) Rishi to share capacity uplift proposal by 2028-05-19.
3) Monica to coordinate CS readiness and onboarding checklist.

If you prefer a short call to align rather than email, happy to set 30 minutes next week.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on the renewal.

—
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BrightLeaf_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx, Redwood_QBR_Agenda_v1.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 11 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: BrightLeaf renewal — timeline, staffing, QBR window

Soojin — adding a quick ops note so we can hand this off cleanly once Maria confirms dates.

Ops checklist (high level):
- CS owner: Monica Patel (onboarding, runbook, staging tests)
- SRE readiness: schedule capacity validation (Rishi to propose slot)
- Data retention / logs: compile current retention docs for procurement
- Training plan: short enablement for BrightLeaf infra team (30–60m)
- Post-QBR 30-day success metrics and cadence (SLA + latency targets)

I can draft the runbook and staging checklist by 2028-05-17. If Maria confirms a QBR slot, I'll put a calendar hold and invite the technical contacts.

Also flagging a potential procurement ask: BrightLeaf usually requests SOC2 artifact proof and a short network diagram for VPC peering. We should have those ready by the 05-22 security checkpoint. Stephanie — can you confirm the legal/billing signoff timeline so we can match procurement expectations?

Thanks — Monica

Hi Soojin / team —

Appreciate the clear plan. We are aligned on the overall timeline and the target signature date looks fine. A few items from our side:

1) QBR availability — we can do Wed 2028-08-02, 14:00–15:00 PT. Please send an invite to our technical leads (CC'd below).
2) Procurement asks — we'll need SOC2 Type II evidence and a brief network diagram for our security review. Can you provide those by 2028-05-22?
3) Pricing amendment — our procurement lead will share a short redline for the amendment; please expect procurement@brightleaf.com to be on future threads.

Technical contacts (please include in calendar invite):
- Javier Gomez <j.gomez@brightleaf.com> (Infra lead)
- Priya Shah <p.shah@brightleaf.com> (Platform eng)

If you can circulate the MAP draft this week and Rishi's capacity proposal, we'll review and return comments within two business days.

Thanks — Maria

Great — thanks for the fast turnaround, Maria. Wed 2028-08-02 14:00 PT is locked. I'll send the calendar invite after a quick confirmation from Stephanie on legal timing.

Action owners / next steps (summary):
- Soojin: Send MAP v1 (today) and calendar invite for QBR (by EOD 2028-05-12).
- Rishi: Capacity uplift proposal v1 by 2028-05-19 (include throughput model, expected cost delta, and fallback model).
- Monica: Runbook + staging checklist by 2028-05-17 (include post-QBR 30-day metrics).
- Stephanie: Confirm legal/billing review window and whether we should expect an amendment redline from procurement (target signoff 2028-07-15).
- BrightLeaf procurement: Please share any contract constraints or standard terms we should expect.

I've attached the MAP and QBR agenda again. Monica will set the invite once Stephanie gives the green light.

If anything changes on your side (procurement timing or additional stakeholders), please flag here and we'll adapt.

—
